summary: The single remaining blocking issue (R2-01 / T-004) is a LaTeX caption copy-paste error: the subfigure embedding curves_size60000.png carries the caption '$N{=}500$' instead of '$N{=}60{,}000$'. No code, data, analysis, or figure files need to change—only the manuscript LaTeX source. Directive D2-1 already specifies this exact one-word fix and remains active. All prior literature-description directives (D1-1, D1-2) are also retained as they address resolved but still-required text corrections.

decisions.rationale: The underlying figure file (curves_size60000.png) is correct; only the \caption{} text in the LaTeX subfigure block is wrong—a copy-paste error that introduced '$N{=}500$' where '$N{=}60{,}000$' is required. This is a pure manuscript text fix with no upstream computation involved. Directive D2-1 already covers it precisely and must be applied.

report_directives.text: In the LaTeX source, locate the \begin{subfigure} block that contains \includegraphics{../figures/curves_size60000.png} (label fig:curves60k, near L327–L336). Change its \caption{} argument from '$N{=}500$.' to '$N{=}60{,}000$.' Recompile the PDF and confirm that the two subfigures in fig:curves_extremes are captioned '$N{=}500$' (left panel) and '$N{=}60{,}000$' (right panel) respectively, matching the surrounding prose at L345–L349.
